$comment: W45 G0 part 1, the ladders' protocol (charter clause 4; Decision Logs 1, 4 and 5; X57).
Every rung is a complete scratch candidate built by fit/build-candidate.ts from the published c05
documents moved on the leaves its base and its ladder name, drawn in candidate mode in scratch on
the fixed cells below, WebGPU tier, at 2x AND as each cell's 1x twin (X48). Rungs of one content
render once (the overrides compared as content, W44 G1's tracker note). A ladder renders nothing
before part 1 is hashed; what a ladder may decide is `decisions` and nothing else.

fixedCells.rule: named __rest cells only: the six of clause 4's two ladders (the three vetoing mid/thick cells, the two checkerboard-8 thick cells and checkerboard-32__rrect-lg__rest), the fine thick cells of ladder (iv), and the thin cells of ladder (v); each declared by both light 0.25 profiles; none a referee or a holdout scene. A probe scene must be in the planner's pre-gate whitelist (referees/plan.py `pregateProbe`); a calibration scene carries no referee by the planner's own refusal (every referee is a probe scene). The inactive twins of checkerboard-8__rrect-lg__rest and checkerboard-32__rrect-lg__rest are referees and are never rendered before the exposure; no inactive control is rendered.

control.label: c05-control
control.why: c05 unmoved under the scratch key token: its four endpoint digests must be c05's, its 2x and 1x captures pixel-identical to the canonical strict-mode c05 captures of the same cells (the instrument's control), and its 1x captures X48's reference

I.label: base-i
I.why: clause 4 (i)'s fixed point: floor 1, the second tap at share 0.5 and 3 CSS px, the span top at 160 (so 128 sits at farS 0.156 and 160 at 1, while 96 sits at the knee, 0); the operator at its identity

J.label: base-joint
J.why: W44's joint point m3-t0.1 (declaration 66bf5a01…), rebuilt through W45's builder: its four endpoint digests must equal W44's (patch-and-digest identity); ladder (v)'s base, where the thin trade was read (thin start 0.8)

ladders.name: the operator in isolation
ladders.unit: signed fraction of the deep mix, graded on farS
ladders.bar: every `unchanged` cell (span <= 96, where farS is 0) within its T1 bar of the rung at 0 on every rung, and byte-identical; every `monotone` cell's T1 monotone in the delta across the five rungs. The leaf is struck if no `monotone` cell moves by more than its bar between 0 and -1.

ladders.name: the joint composition

references.joint: W44's joint point's committed T1 cells (m3-t0.1, declaration 66bf5a01…)

ladders.bar: on at least one rung, measured as T1 error growth g against EACH reference: md's g < 0 with its T1 above the reference's (rising toward Apple) AND lg's g < 0 with its T1 below the reference's (falling toward Apple), against c05 and against the joint point.
ladders.stop: no rung meets the bar: the wave closes at G0 with the finding, and the operator stays landed inert

ladders.name: the span top at a floor below 1 and at 1
ladders.bar: the transfer per cell and pitch; the leaf is flat at a floor when no cell moves by more than its bar across the grid; its non-flat range the span tops between which some cell moves.

ladders.name: the active thick and far ramp starts
ladders.unit: fraction (the ramp's sharp share at the contour)
ladders.bar: the pair is flat when no fine thick cell moves by more than its bar across the three rungs

ladders.name: the thin-span transfer per lever
ladders.bar: the transfer per thin cell and pitch, T1 web against the rung's own reference (base J, or `against`); a lever SEPARATES when one of its rungs moves every cb4 cell toward Apple (g < 0) and every `others` cell toward Apple. A T cell is read on T1-fine and T1-low. farDelta at thin spans, where farS is 0, must leave every thin cell byte-identical.

checks.control: c05-control's four endpoint digests are c05's; its 2x and 1x captures pixel-identical to the canonical strict-mode c05 captures of the same cells (PNG SHA-256s reported)
checks.joint: base-joint's four endpoint digests are W44's m3-t0.1's
checks.x48: every rung's 1x captures pixel-identical to c05-control's 1x captures
checks.loader: every rendered and read row is a fixed cell's: no referee, no holdout, no inactive row (cuts/bed.py's refusals and the fixed list)

decisions.strike: remove a draft leaf whose ladder reads it flat (for the operator: ladder (i) with no monotone cell moving by more than its bar)
decisions.narrow: replace a draft grid by a non-empty subset of itself inside its ladder's non-flat range
decisions.inert: replace a draft PENDING inert setting by the ladder evidence that proves it; the value does not change
decisions.stop: ladder (ii) with no rung meeting its bar closes the wave at G0; part 2 is then not hashed

notDecided: no value is chosen by a ladder: the fit chooses, inside the hashed part 2
ladder (v) decides nothing in part 2: it is Decision Log 5's reading, and a non-separating result names the thin trade as a residual
no grid is widened or shifted and no leaf is added after part 1
